theorem ThreeSum1960614.quartic_geometry (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (1 / 2)) :
    0 < phiDeriv t ∧ phiDeriv t < 9 ∧
    phi tangentPoint + (t - tangentPoint) * phiDeriv tangentPoint ≤ phi t  := by sorry
natural_language_statement: For every real t in the closed interval [0,1/2], the exact expansion-232 quartic has derivative strictly between 0 and 9, and its tangent at the fixed rational point 0.17200068185091493 lies below it. Both endpoints are included. The explicit polynomial and derivative are supplied by the shared analytic definitions.
